markets.online_save_the_date: Etsy #2; Greetings Island fills the shopping pack (USD 8.99, 'Print, Download or Send Online'); PAA: 'How far out do you send save the date?', 'What is a free app for making wedding invitations?', 'Is Canva or Zola better for wedding invitations?'; Reddit and Facebook perspectives ask for sites that collect addresses and track RSVPs.

cross_market_insights: AU page 1 is almost entirely Etsy listings, local stationers and Pinterest; only one editorial guide (WedBuild, a website-builder competitor) appears in the AU top 3. Transactional template intent dominates.
London and US surface platforms (Paperless Post, Canva, Bliss & Bone, Greetings Island, The Knot). Related searches ask for RSVP, free options, Canva and collecting addresses.

Nobody in the top results covers guests flying in from several countries: international text delivery limits, WhatsApp delivery, time zones, passport validity reminders or linking the save the date to a travel and accommodation page.

Nobody separates 'design a file' (Etsy, Canva, stationers) from 'send and track' platforms (Paperless Post, Greenvelope, Greetings Island, Bliss & Bone), which is the real decision for a couple with 80 to 150 guests.
The Knot, Zola, Hitched and WeddingWire rank but are blocked domains; they can be read for structure only.
payload.recommended_angle: A sites list in the format of our live bridal shower invitations sibling, sorted by what each platform does (send and track versus design a file), written for couples whose guests travel internationally, with the save the date pointing to a free Wonderland Studio website that carries travel details and RSVPs.
